title: spiraea alba var. septentrionalis
intro: Spiraea alba var. septentrionalis, commonly known as Northern White Spiraea, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to North America. This shrub has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, colds, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Spiraea alba var. septentrionalis include acting as an expectorant, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which help to relieve symptoms such as coughing, congestion, and skin irritations. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
